# source: minted manual (v3.7), Commands and environments: the minted
# environment with its mandatory {language} argument and linenos option;
# \mint, \mintinline, \inputminted; \setminted, \setmintedinline and
# \usemintedstyle configuration. Environment and command capture preserve
# source literally: \mint and \mintinline read their code braced or between
# two copies of a delimiter, as minted does. \mint is the environment of one
# line; \mintinline is inline code, set in the mono family alone, so it takes
# the size, weight, slant and colour around it. Lean 4, Python, Bash, shell
# sessions and plain text are classified after capture by mirrors of
# Pygments' own lexers; another name Pygments' registry holds asks the
# installed Pygments and ships plain source where none answers; a name the
# registry does not hold is named (W0412) with the nearest one it does.
# \inputminted reads a file — a driver request later; the short forms and
# external Pygments machinery refuse by name.
body impl \begin{minted}{python} print(1) \end{minted}
body impl \begin{minted}[linenos]{python} print(1) \end{minted}
body impl \begin{minted}{C++} int x; \end{minted}
body refuse:W0110 \begin{minted}{Python 3} print(1) \end{minted}
body impl \mint{python}|print(1)|
body impl \mint{python}{print(1)}
body impl \mintinline{python}|print(1)|
body impl \mintinline{python}{print(1)}
body impl \mintinline[fontsize=\small]{python}{print(1)}
body refuse:W0412 \mintinline{pythn}{print(1)}
body refuse:W0301 \inputminted{python}{example.py}
pre inert:binds \setminted{linenos}
pre inert:binds \setminted[python]{fontsize=\small,tabsize=3,breaklines}
pre inert:binds \setmintedinline{fontsize=\relax}
pre inert:binds \setmintedinline[python]{fontsize=\small}
body impl \setmintedinline{fontsize=\large}\mintinline{python}{print(1)}
body impl \setminted{fontsize=\small,tabsize=3,breaklines}\begin{minted}{text} Alpha Bravo \end{minted}
body impl \setminted[python]{fontsize=\scriptsize}\begin{minted}{python} print(1) \end{minted}
body impl \begin{minted}[fontsize=auto,breaklines=false]{text} Alpha Bravo \end{minted}
body impl \setminted{style=friendly}\begin{minted}{python} def probe(): return 7 \end{minted}
body impl \setminted[python]{style=friendly}\begin{minted}[style=default]{python} def probe(): return 7 \end{minted}
body impl \begin{minted}[style=friendly]{lean} def probe := 7 \end{minted}
body refuse:W0110 \begin{minted}[fontsize=small]{text} Alpha Bravo \end{minted}
body refuse:W0110 \begin{minted}[style=unknown-style]{python} print(1) \end{minted}
body refuse:W0110 \setminted{unknownsetting=on}\begin{minted}{text} Alpha Bravo \end{minted}
body refuse:N0102 \begin{minted}[formatcom=\itshape]{python} print(1) \end{minted}
pre refuse:W0301 \usemintedstyle{tango}
pre refuse:W0301 \newminted{python}{linenos}
# \setminted binds global or exact-lexer defaults. Environment options win;
# language defaults beat global defaults even when the latter are newer.
# \setmintedinline binds inline code's own layers after both of them, and
# fontsize=\relax there keeps the size around the code.
# Fontsize accepts named size commands (\small) and auto; bare names are
# literal text in FancyVerb and are diagnosed with the corrected spelling.
# tabsize uses positive stops through 100; breaklines wraps at whitespace.
# A token paints in its code role: a colour the palette names for the role
# or derives for it, else the default or friendly style's colour for the
# role, from Pygments' own tables. Other Pygments styles are diagnosed, and
# a natively classified listing executes no external highlighter. formatcom
# runs TeX on the Pygments formatter's macros, which no part of the engine
# runs: it is noted once (N0102). Additional fvextra keys remain W0110.
